description: POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/reviews/{review_id}/events: submit the caller's pending review as APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES, or COMMENT, publishing every comment added to it. `body` is the review summary (required by GitHub for REQUEST_CHANGES and COMMENT when the pending review has no body).

review_id.description: The pending review's id (from create_pull_request_review). Looked up when omitted: the caller's one PENDING review on the pull request.
